metadata.title: मैं भी भारत की टीम मध्य प्रदेश में । Main Bhi Bharat team in Madhya Pradesh
metadata.description:
Our team left Delhi this morning, and has now reached Madhya Pradesh. On this tour, we will first go to Khargone. We will also be traveling to Badwani, Alirajpur and Jhabua. We plan to bring lots of ground reports and episodes of The Tribal Kitchen for you from there. So stay tuned, and thank you for your support.

#Madhya_Pradesh #Main_Bhi_Bharat
